name: costingly
description: Query your own bank and credit-card transactions, synced from Plaid into a local database.
long_description:
Costingly keeps a private copy of your bank and credit-card transactions in a PostgreSQL database on this machine, synced from your banks through Plaid. Nothing is sent anywhere: the database listens only on this machine's loopback interface, unreachable from the network, and Claude reads it through views that cannot reach your stored bank credentials.

Ask about spending, income, balances or accounts in plain language. Claude writes the SQL.

plaid_client_id.title: Plaid client ID
plaid_client_id.description: From your Plaid dashboard. Leave blank to browse an empty database.

plaid_secret.title: Plaid secret
plaid_secret.description: Your Plaid production secret. Stored in the OS keychain, never sent to the model.
